question: Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.
sql:
-- Final query with proper types
WITH director_movies AS (
    SELECT dm.name_id, n.name, m.id as movie_id, m.date_published, m.duration
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
),
director_ratings AS (
    SELECT dm.name_id, 
           AVG(r.avg_rating) as avg_rating_all,
           SUM(r.total_votes) as total_votes_all,
           MIN(r.avg_rating) as min_rating,
           MAX(r.avg_rating) as max_rating
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN ratings r ON dm.movie_id = r.movie_id
    GROUP BY dm.name_id
),
director_movie_gaps AS (
    SELECT name_id,
           movie_id,
           date_published,
           LAG(date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published) as prev_date
    FROM director_movies
),
director_avg_gap AS (
    SELECT name_id,
           ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_published - prev_date))) as avg_inter_movie_duration
    FROM director_movie_gaps
    WHERE prev_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY name_id
),
director_stats AS (
    SELECT dm.name_id, n.name,
           COUNT(*) as movie_count,
           SUM(m.duration) as total_duration,
           dr.avg_rating_all,
           dr.total_votes_all,
           dr.min_rating,
           dr.max_rating
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    JOIN director_ratings dr ON dm.name_id = dr.name_id
    GROUP BY dm.name_id, n.name, dr.avg_rating_all, dr.total_votes_all, dr.min_rating, dr.max_rating
)
SELECT CAST(ds.name_id AS TEXT) as name_id,
       ds.name,
       CAST(ds.movie_count AS INTEGER) as movie_count,
       CAST(dag.avg_inter_movie_duration AS INTEGER) as avg_inter_movie_duration,
       ROUND(ds.avg_rating_all, 2) as avg_rating,
       CAST(ds.total_votes_all AS INTEGER) as total_votes,
       ds.min_rating,
       ds.max_rating,
       CAST(ds.total_duration AS INTEGER) as total_movie_duration
FROM director_stats ds
JOIN director_avg_gap dag ON ds.name_id = dag.name_id
ORDER BY ds.movie_count DESC, ds.total_duration DESC
LIMIT 9

The movies table holds core film details. The ratings, director_mapping, genre, and role_mapping tables record specific events or transactions linking people to films. The names table serves as a lookup for person descriptions. The ERD table is metadata only. The movies table connects to the ratings, director_mapping, genre, and role_mapping tables via movies.id to ratings.movie_id, director_mapping.movie_id, genre.movie_id, and role_mapping.movie_id.
